transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for making the change-control huddle. As you know, we're looking at the firmware retrofit for Welding Cell 5, tentatively scheduled for Friday before the next production run. Before I authorize this work, I need to hear from each of you on any requirements or concerns. Controls engineering -- anything we need to be aware of on the technical side? Production planning -- any conflicts with the Friday production schedule? Quality -- any validation or documentation requirements? Let's go around the room.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety issue. I confirmed with the controller vendor yesterday that there's a safety bulletin identifying an interlock race in the current firmware running on Welding Cell 5. This means the retrofit isn't just a support lifecycle issue -- it must be completed before the cell's next production run. The work requires exactly 6 hours of energized lockout and post-update safety-I/O validation. I should also note that the vendor bulletin has not yet been attached to the work order, so we need to get that documented before proceeding.
